बॉलीवुड में दो नए स्टार किड्स की एंट्री से जबरदस्त हलचल मच गई है! 🎬💥

डायरेक्टर शशांक खेतान ने अपनी नई रोमांटिक रिवेंज ड्रामा फिल्म Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahin Kahin का ऐलान कर दिया है। इस फिल्म से प्रोड्यूसर साजिद नाडियाडवाला और वर्दा नाडियाडवाला के बेटे सुभान और एक्टर रोहित रॉय व मानसी जोशी रॉय की बेटी ऐरा अपना बॉलीवुड डेब्यू करने जा रहे हैं।

फिल्म के टाइटल वीडियो और फर्स्ट लुक में दोनों एक्टर्स जख्मी हालत में एक-दूसरे की बाहों में नजर आ रहे हैं। मेकर्स के मुताबिक, यह लव, पैशन और रिवेंज से भरपूर कहानी है। दिलचस्प बात यह है कि फिल्म का टाइटल साजिद नाडियाडवाला की दिवंगत पूर्व पत्नी दिव्या भारती की फिल्म Deewana के सुपरहिट गाने से लिया गया है।

यह फिल्म 214 Entertainment के बैनर तले बन रही है, जिसे शशांक, अमित चंद्रा और नलिनी दत्ता खेतान ने बनाया है। फिल्म का म्यूजिक T-Series रिलीज करेगा और अमाल मलिक इसके गानों को कंपोज करने के साथ अपनी आवाज भी देंगे।

क्या आप सुभान और ऐरा की इस नई जोड़ी को बड़े पर्दे पर देखने के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? हमें कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Sajid Nadiadwala’s son Subhaan and Rohit Roy’s daughter Airah to debut with Shashaank Khaitaan's Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahin Kahin, release date out
ctx.summary: Titled Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahin Kahin, the romantic revenge drama will introduce Subhaan and Airah as its lead pair.
ctx.text:
Filmmaker Shashank Khaitaan is back with a love story, but his next film comes with a twist. After introducing new faces Ishaan Khatter and Janhvi Kapoor in Dhadak, the filmmaker is set to do the same with his upcoming directorial. Titled Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahin Kahin, the romantic revenge drama will introduce Subhaan and Airah as its lead pair. While Subhaan is the son of producer Sajid Nadiadwala and Warda Nadiadwala, Airah, whose real name is Kiara Bose Roy, is the daughter of actors Rohit Roy and Mansi Joshi Roy.
The makers announced the project with a title reveal video that gives viewers a brief look at what to expect. It opens with a romantic moment between two lovers before taking a darker turn, suggesting that their relationship may not be as straightforward as it first appears. The makers have described the film as a romantic revenge drama, with love, passion and revenge forming the heart of the story. However, they have chosen to keep the plot and details about the characters under wraps for now.
Wrapped in each other's arms in the first look, the actors are bloody and bruised whilst sharing a kiss. The caption on X read, “Yeh Deewane hain kuch aur tarah ke.... Kuch aur tarah ki deewangi....❤️‍🔥.” Interestingly, the title of the movie Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahin Kahin is a song from Sajid Nadiadwala's late ex-wife Divya Bharti's song from the movie Deewana, which also marked Bollywood debut of Shah Rukh Khan.
The film also marks a new production venture for Shashank. Aisi Deewangi Dekhi Nahin Kahin is being made under 214 Entertainment, a banner founded by Shashaank, Amit Chandrra and Nalini Datta Khaitaan. The film is produced by Shashaank, Amit Chandrra, Nalini Datta Khaitaan and Karishma Thakker. He has written and directed the project.
Music will be an important part of the film, with T-Series set to release its soundtrack. Amaal Mallik will compose and lend his voice to the songs, while Kunaal Vermaa has written the lyrics.
Shashank made his directorial debut with Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania in 2014. The romantic comedy, starring Varun Dhawan and Alia Bhatt, was followed by Badrinath Ki Dulhania in 2017. He then directed Dhadak in 2018, which introduced Janhvi Kapoor alongside Ishaan Khatter. The Hindi film was an adaptation of the Marathi film Sairat.
Over the years, HE has also worked as a writer and producer on several Hindi films. His credits include Dharma Productions' projects Good Newwz (2019), Govinda Naam Mera (2022) and Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani (2023).
